Plot fitted individual trajectories

Source: R/plot.R
plot_individual.Rd

Generates (or reuses) fitted-participant latent trajectory summaries and combines them with observations, censoring indicators, and assay limits.

Usage

plot_individual(
  x,
  participant,
  times = 0:150,
  ndraws = 500,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  scale = c("response", "model"),
  biomarkers = NULL,
  central = c("median", "mean"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An epikinetics_fit or individual epikinetics_prediction object.

participant

One fitted participant id.

times, ndraws, probs, scale, biomarkers

Passed to predict(). Ignored when x is already a prediction object.

central

Plot the posterior median or mean trajectory.

...

Reserved for future methods.

Value

An ordinary ggplot object.
